title.narrative: Enhancing business acceleration services through public-private partnership approach

description.narrative: The Abu Dhabi Declaration, adopted at the eighteenth session of the General Conference (GC.18) on 5 November 2019, underlined the crucial role of UNIDO in providing a platform to coordinate and catalyse initiatives of and with private sector entities. The Declaration called for UNIDO to spearhead such efforts through coordination, knowledge-sharing and targeted support to UNIDO#s Member States. Building on the above, the main project objective is to systematize partnerships with and among the E4Impact programme partners, to achieve synergies and scale as well as to contribute to accelerating the growth of Kenyan Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs).
